rationale: Agent demonstrates strong troubleshooting methodology by systematically ruling out common causes (team size, project scope, errors/slowdowns) before diving into technical investigation. Empathy is present throughout—agent validates the customer's concern as 'unusual' and commits to investigation. Resolution is clear: specific next steps (API log review, screen share at 2 PM tomorrow, team-side logging) with concrete deliverables (calendar invite, Zoom link). Tone is professional and reassuring without being robotic.
